# Close wrap, Mon 2026-11-02 (~4:20 PM ET)

1. **Mixed close; tech rally faded again.** Dow +0.60%, S&P 500 -0.26%, Nasdaq -0.68%; NYSE breadth 1842 up / 958 down. Consumer services, financials, materials led; oil & gas, tech, healthcare lagged ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stocks-mixed-at-close-of-trade-dow-jones-industrial-average-up-060-4992666); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-earnings-oil-iran-048328e49e47ce7afe6c1fb9d9acf13d)).
2. **Oil -7.6%, Brent $104.77** on US-Iran peace-talk hopes; airlines and cruise lines rallied, energy worst sector. Energy group stays in avoid ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-earnings-oil-iran-048328e49e47ce7afe6c1fb9d9acf13d)).
3. **Movers:** IDXX +21.85% to $671.64 (Q3 EPS $4.01 vs $3.71, FY26 guide raised) ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/IDXX?date=2026-11-02&view=daily&measure=change); [Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/11/62781525/idexx-laboratories-perion-network-tat-technologies-and-other-big-stocks-moving-higher-on-monday)). EL mixed after beat-and-raise; ORCL down on $20B debt+equity raise; LITE down after MRVL deal ([Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/audio/2026-11-02/stock-movers-lumentum-oracle-and-estee-lauder-podcast)). AAPL -1.83% to $338.32 into earnings ([Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/AAPL)). MAR +5% early on raised FY guide ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/earnings-results-wrap-apple-close-143600728.html)).
4. **After hours:** PLTR Q3 adj EPS $0.44 vs $0.41, rev $2.31B vs $2.18B, FY rev guide raised to ~$8.53B; stock closed -3.13% at $178.34 before the print ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/palantir-pltr-earnings-q3-2026.html); [Exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/PLTR?date=2026-11-02&view=daily&measure=change)). AAPL results pending (est. EPS $1.99, rev $113.4B; call 5 PM ET) ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/apple-aapl-q4-2026-earnings-live-updates.html)). ROKU, LSCC also AMC.
5. **Tomorrow:** midterms, JOLTS 10:00; AMD, AMGN AMC.

## Swing ideas
- **MAR** long, low. Q3 EPS $3.02 beat, FY EPS guide raised, plus lower fuel costs for travel; non-tech beat-and-raise. Risk: oil snaps back if Iran talks stall; revenue slightly missed.
- **EL** (from pre-market) hold, no re-add.
